title: state.json (orchestrator snapshot)
description: Schema for mission orchestrator state. Tracks current mission progress, active worker, and milestone status.

workingDirectory.description: Absolute path to the target code workspace

currentFeatureId.description: Feature currently being worked on, or null if idle

currentWorkerSessionId.description: Active worker session UUID, or null if no worker active

currentWorkerPid.description: PID of the current worker process, or null

workerSessionIds.description: Complete history of all spawned worker session UUIDs

completedFeatures.description: Count of features with status completed

totalFeatures.description: Total number of features in the mission

milestonesWithValidationPlanned.description: Milestones that have validation orchestration scheduled

lastReviewedHandoffCount.description: Number of handoff documents the orchestrator has processed

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last state update
